[size=3][i]amber paper lanterns, glowing jellies & deep-sea blue… a cozy harbour room after dark ✨[/i][/size]

[img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/post/674aa5d4-6ecf-4f54-87c2-47f4b7c8fece_night-market-lanterns-lantern-string.gif[/img] [img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/post/f3f1a46f-9f89-4f92-8b1a-af17e88aa302_night-market-lanterns-jellyfish-tank.gif[/img] [img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/post/70b4b89f-3a66-4cac-9e99-ee2e4b3eb1ff_night-market-lanterns-galley-stove.gif[/img]

[img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/post/8cd634cb-9335-4403-84cf-d7fcfe512ebf_night-market-lanterns-paper-lantern.gif[/img] [img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/post/394419b7-5ad1-47fe-93b6-81bc5ab4dd35_night-market-lanterns-jellyfish-jar.gif[/img][/center]

Hi hi! 💜 I made you [b]32 new items[/b] for a lantern-lit harbour home in Stardew Valley: [b]26 furniture pieces, 3 wallpapers and 3 floors[/b] 🌙 From a carved boat bed you can really sleep in to a violet jellyfish tank that glows in the dark ✨

[size=4][b]🌟 Quick peek[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]🪄 [b]26 furniture pieces[/b] · [b]3 wallpapers[/b] · [b]3 floors[/b][/*]
[*]💡 [b]10 lights[/b] · 🌈 with [b]Furniture Framework[/b], every lantern, jelly and porthole glows in [b]its own color[/b][/*]
[*]🛏️ sleepable boat bed · 🪑 chairs, stool, bench & armchair you can sit on · 🖼️ 5 wall pieces · 🌀 woven rug[/*]
[*]📜 everything is sold at [b]Robin's[/b][/*]
[*]💾 works on your [b]existing saves[/b] · Stardew Valley [b]1.6[/b] · needs [b]SMAPI[/b] + [b]Content Patcher[/b][/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/6685/images/1866/1866-1793235507-132687580.png[/img][/center]

[size=4][b]🎨 Made by me, pixel by pixel[/b][/size]
I [b]love[/b] making pixel art 🥹💕 Every single piece here (and every lantern, jelly and glow) was made in [b]The Pixel Loom[/b], my very own pixel-art tool ✨ No store-bought assets, just me and my Loom having way too much fun.
🌸 Find my art packs & more on [url=https://nogitsunegurl.itch.io]my itch.io page[/url] 💜

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/6685/images/1866/1866-1793235507-132687580.png[/img][/center]

[size=4][b]🌈 Every light has its own color[/b][/size]
[center][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/post/a33677ad-8946-4097-8f02-37a441e30c82_night-market-lanterns-lights-off-on.png[/img][/center]
Grab the optional [b]Furniture Framework[/b] file and each light shines in its [b]own color[/b], right where it lives ✨
[list]
[*]🕯️ amber for the paper lantern, float sconce, dock post and galley stove[/*]
[*]🧪 teal for the jellyfish jar, blue for the porthole, violet for the jellyfish tank and pink for the pearl and coral lamps[/*]
[*]💫 the lantern string lights all [b]five[/b] of its lanterns, each in its own color[/*]
[*]🌞 click a light to switch it on or off[/*]
[/list][b]No Furniture Framework?[/b] Everything still works with just Content Patcher! The 10 lights switch on at night and their lanterns, jellies and fire look lit, but the light they cast is the game's [b]standard white[/b]:
[list]
[*]the teal jar, blue porthole, violet tank and the pink pearl and coral lamps lose their color and light the room white[/*]
[*]the amber lamp, sconce, lantern string, dock post and galley stove use the game's usual warm-white lamp light[/*]
[*]the lantern string casts one light instead of five[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/6685/images/1866/1866-1793235507-132687580.png[/img][/center]

[spoiler]
[b]📥 Install steps[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b] (and [b]Furniture Framework[/b] if you want the colored lights).[/*]
[*]Close Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Unzip [b]one[/b] file into your [b]Mods[/b] folder so the folders inside sit directly in Mods, e.g. [b]Mods/[CP] Night Market Lanterns/manifest.json[/b] (no extra folder in between).[/*]
[*]Start the game through SMAPI and visit [b]Robin[/b] 🪵💜[/*]
[/list][b]Updating:[/b] delete the old Night Market Lanterns folders first, then unzip the new ones.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]❓ FAQ[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]❓ Questions & fixes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Nothing at Robin's?[/b] Check the SMAPI console for errors, make sure Content Patcher is installed and there's only one copy of each Night Market Lanterns folder, then restart the game.[/*]
[*][b]Do I need a new save?[/b] Nope! It works on existing saves 💾 Before removing the mod, pick up the pieces first or they'll vanish.[/*]
[*][b]Does it replace anything?[/b] No, it only adds new furniture, wallpapers and floors, so it plays nice with other furniture mods.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer?[/b] Yes, but every player needs the same version installed.[/*]
[*][b]Can I sit on the chairs?[/b] Yes! The deckhand chair, barrel stool, rope bench and clamshell armchair are all seats 🪑[/*]
[*][b]Are the gallery pics real gameplay?[/b] They're cozy scenes I staged with the mod's own sprites and a pretend night 🌙 In game the lights are steady (the little flicker is only in the preview GIFs), and your game may look a tiny bit different.[/*]
[*][b]I don't see the colored glow?[/b] Colored light needs the Furniture Framework version, and lights only show when it's dark (night or rain). Click a lamp to switch it on.[/*]
[*][b]Found a bug?[/b] Tell me in the Posts or Bugs tab with your game + mod version and I'll do my best to help 💜[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
